title: Dedication of the Basilicas of Sts. Peter and Paul
subtitle: Optional Memorial · Acts 28:11-16, 30-31; Mt 14:22-33 (also St. Rose Philippine Duchesne)
text: Four hundred years ago today, on November 18, 1626, Pope Urban VIII consecrated the new St. Peter's Basilica, built over the tomb of the fisherman who sank in the waves until Christ caught his hand. Today the Church also honors St. Paul Outside the Walls, raised over the Apostle's grave. Pray the Creed slowly today.
